title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2025
part_text: as the basis for a genuine EDU
part_context: Stresses that unprecedented threats and shifting geopolitics profoundly affect the EU’s strategic interests; underlines the need for a common threat perception and public awareness; underscores that these challenges and opportunities make it urgent to implement the CSDP as the basis for a genuine EDU and, ideally, to seize this pivotal moment to strengthen the effectiveness of existing instruments and, where appropriate, to advance cooperation between the Member States within the current framework of the Treaties;
